headline: Energy plan edits and a TitanGen SmartBoard and EV presentation are on the agenda.
summary: The meeting will include a TitanGen SmartBoard and EV presentation or update, and edits to the energy plan. It will also cover updates from Dave Oakes, a city department roundtable issues review, and approval of the 2027 meeting calendar.
